basis: Measured image-space correspondences; selected purple rear-trunk anchors fit with RANSAC; foreground is tested against that model.
anchor_filter: At f90, native HSV H120–175,S>60,V>30,x in .71–.80 frame width, within the reviewed trunk ROI. Initial rectangular ROI mixed depth planes and its raw median was not used as a layer measurement.
interpretation: Foreground and rear-trunk image motion are incompatible with this single fitted similarity transform. This supports a layered/parallax-style reconstruction; it does not uniquely recover the original camera or prove a particular rig.
limits: Only 20 frame intervals at 60fps. Tracks originate in a 512x288 proxy and are rescaled to native units; fine motion and occlusion remain uncertain. Foreground tracking fails after f110.
